title: npm run fast runs the tree-wide rule tests a new file or hook trips
body:
Source: PR for t-ctnaq2e, Check run 43741060768: five tests failed in CI that `npm run fast` passed locally (test/rules/context-budget.test.ts, test/tool-scope.test.ts boundaries BINARIES, test/cli/hook.test.ts, test/rules/host-path-guard.test.mjs, test/import-boundary.test.ts) after adding src/hook/edit-standards.ts, a PreToolUse entry in .claude/settings.json and a new fixture.
Why: fast's related-test selection misses the rule tests that read every file of the tree, so a new src module, hook or fixture costs one red CI round (~15 min) each time.
Outcome: `npm run fast` runs the tree-wide rule tests (boundaries over untracked files, host-path guard, receivers registry, context-budget when .claude/settings.json changes, cli usage tests when src/cli/hook.ts changes) whenever a file is added or settings change.
Files: scripts/fast-check.ts, test/scripts/fast-check.test.ts
Proof: replaying the t-ctnaq2e first commit (cad4c51) through fast reports FAIL naming the five tests.
Predicted: proof stop-refusals <= 1
